decks.name: Annie Christmas
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set tales-of-amaze. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Annie Christmas
hero.specialAbility:
NECKLACE OF PEARLS
Add +2 to the value of Annie's attacks if she has less health than the defender.

cards.title: A Few More Pearls
cards.basicText: Deal 2 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to Annie.

cards.title: Better Together
cards.afterText: If your fighter is adjacent to a friendly fighter, your fighter and each friendly fighter adjacent to them recover 1 health.

cards.title: Bottom Dealing
cards.duringText: Reveal the bottom card of your deck. Increase the value of this card by the BOOST value of the revealed card, then put the revealed card on the top or the bottom of your deck.

cards.title: Captain's Orders
cards.basicText: Place Annie in any empty space in her zone. Then, place another friendly fighter in an empty space in Annie's zone. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Keep Your Hands to Yourself
cards.afterText: Move each fighter in the combat up to 2 space.

cards.title: Lagniappe
cards.immediateText: Deal up to 2 damage to Annie to draw that many cards. (This may cause her special ability to apply.)

cards.title: Long Shot
cards.duringText: If the opposing fighter is not adjacent to your fighter, this card's value is 5 instead.

cards.title: Mississippi Queen
cards.immediateText: Damage cannot reduce Annie's health below 1 this turn.

cards.title: Quite a Pair
cards.immediateText: You may reveal two cards from your hand with the same name. If you do, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Slick Talker
cards.immediateText: Annie and Charlie may swap spaces. If they do, your other fighter is now the defender.

cards.title: Striking Beauty
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter. If you won the combat, deal 2 damage instead.

cards.title: The Turn and the River
cards.afterText: Draw 2 cards.

decks.name: Golden Bat
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set tales-of-amaze. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Golden Bat
hero.specialAbility:
THE FIRST SUPERHERO
If you haven't taken a Maneuver action this turn, add +2 to the value of Golden Bat's attacks.

cards.title: Alpine Fortress
cards.basicText: Choose a card in your discard pile and shuffle it into your deck. Draw 2 cards. Move Golden Bat up to 4 spaces.

cards.title: Arrive Just in Time
cards.basicText: Place Golden Bat in any space.

cards.title: A Punch to Shake the Earth
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in your zone. If you won the combat, deal 2 damage instead.

cards.title: Imposing Presence
cards.immediateText: Cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Insight of the Ancients
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, return a random card in your discard pile to your hand.

cards.title: Like a Flash of Golden Light
cards.duringText: If Golden Bat shares no zones with the space he started this turn in, this card's value is 4 instead.
cards.afterText: Move Golden Bat up to 5 spaces.

cards.title: Sight Beyond Sight
cards.afterText: Look at the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. Put them back in any order.

cards.title: Skirmish
cards.afterText: If you won the combat, move one of the fighters in the combat up to 2 spaces.

cards.title: Terrifying Roar
cards.immediateText: Fighters cannot leave their spaces for the rest of the turn.

cards.title: Vaporizing Eyebeams
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 1 random card.

decks.name: Dr. Jill Trent
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set tales-of-amaze. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Dr. Jill Trent
hero.specialAbility:
GADGETOLOGY
At the start of your turn, activate one of your gadgets. Whenever Jill Trent attacks, resolve the active gadget's effect.

cards.title: Ace Fighter
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Battle of Wits
cards.afterText: Reveal the top card of your deck and your opponent's deck. If your card has a higher BOOST value, deal 3 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Caught Red-Handed
cards.afterText: Your opponent discards 1 card. If you won the combat, they discard 2 cards instead.

cards.title: Energizing Spray
cards.afterText: Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Gyroscopic Jetpack
cards.afterText: Move your fighter up to 2 spaces. They may move through opposing fighters.

cards.title: Helpful Assistant
cards.basicText: Shuffle up to 3 Jill Trent cards in your discard pile back into your deck. Draw 1 card.

cards.title: Hypnotist
cards.immediateText: If your active gadget is Hypnoray Blaster, cancel all effects on your opponent's card.

cards.title: Indestructible Cloth
cards.immediateText: This combat, your fighter does not take damage from effects other than combat damage.

cards.title: Insightful Deduction
cards.afterText: Reveal the top 3 cards of your opponent's deck. Put one of them on the bottom of the deck and the rest on top in any order.

cards.title: Laser Pen
cards.afterText: Deal 1 damage to the opposing fighter.

cards.title: Sisters in Arms
cards.basicText: This card's effects cannot be canceled. If Daisy and Jill Trent are adjacent and Daisy is attacking, Daisy gains the effect of Jill Trent's gadget.

cards.title: Stasis Diffuser
cards.immediateText: The value of your opponent's card is equal to its printed value and cannot be changed.

cards.title: Utility Belt
cards.afterText: Choose one: ► Jill Trent recovers 1 health ► move Jill Trent 1 space ► draw 1 card

ruleCards.title: Hypnoray Blaster
ruleCards.content: DURING COMBAT: If your card's printed value is lower than your opponent's, reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. Increase the value of your attack by the BOOST value of the revealed card.

ruleCards.title: Ultrabiotic Tonic
ruleCards.content: AFTER COMBAT: If your card's printed value is higher than your opponent's, Jill Trent recovers 1 health.

decks.name: Nikola Tesla
decks.note: Unmatched (Restoration Games), set tales-of-amaze. Datos transcritos de las cartas; uso privado.

hero.name: Nikola Tesla
hero.specialAbility:
ELECTRICAL OVERFLOW
Start the game with 1 coil charged. At the end of your turn, charge 1 coil. At the start of your turn, if both coils are charged, deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter adjacent to Tesla and move them up to 1 space.

cards.title: 7 Hertz
cards.afterText: You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Gain 1 action. ⚡⚡ - Also, draw 1 card.

cards.title: Death Ray
cards.duringText: You may discharge coils: ⚡ - This card's value is 5. ⚡⚡ - Instead, this card's value is 7.

cards.title: Intense Experimentation
cards.afterText: Draw 1 card. You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Instead, draw 2 cards. ⚡⚡ - Instead, draw 3 cards and Tesla recovers 1 health.

cards.title: Kinetic Induction
cards.afterText: Charge one coil. If you won the combat, charge both.

cards.title: Lightning Storm
cards.afterText: You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Deal 1 damage to each opposing fighter in your zone. ⚡⚡ - Instead, deal 2 damage.

cards.title: Polyphase Coils
cards.immediateText: You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Cancel all effects on your opponent's card. ⚡⚡ - Also, ignore that card's value.

cards.title: Remote Control
cards.basicText: Move all opposing fighters up to 2 spaces. Gain 1 action.

cards.title: Repulsion Blast
cards.afterText: Move the opposing fighter up to 2 spaces. You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Also, move Tesla up to 2 spaces. ⚡⚡ - Also, your opponent discards 1 random card.

cards.title: The Alternating Current
cards.afterText: Choose one: ► Charge both coils ► Discharge both coils to have Tesla recover 2 health

cards.title: X-Ray Radiation
cards.duringText: Reveal the top card of your opponent's deck. You may discharge coils: ⚡ - Discard that card. ⚡⚡ - Also add its BOOST value to this card's value.
